brief: Three bases arranged around an empty spot, with a bay tray standing in that spot.

requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot
requirements.evidence: Three full bases at piece:-1,1,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full encircle cell q0,r0,level0. No base occupies 0,0, leaving an empty hex cell surrounded on three sides.

requirements.requirement: Bay tray standing in that empty spot
requirements.evidence: Bay bay:0#0,0#bay4 (hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid) placed at q0,r0,level0, k=4, filling the empty spot between the three bases. check_build meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built three-base cluster around central void with bay tray in void. Started from single base, repositioned to form triangular arrangement at -1,1 / 0,1 / 1,0 around 0,0, then added bay hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid at 0,0. Verified with check_build: ok and meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
